function: no_learning: the DNN only predicts OP, ASER, EC and optimum rate/power values from system parameters (pp. 10-11, 15-16); link design and optimization are closed-form analysis and KKT (pp. 8-10).
notes: Excluded as no_learning. The contribution is a closed-form analysis of OP, ASER and EC over dGG fading (Section III, pp. 8-9) and a closed-form KKT power optimization (Section IV, pp. 9-10); IRS selection is the non-learned maximum-SNR rule (p. 6). The DNN is an offline surrogate: p. 10: "This section presents the DNN framework designed for forecasting the OP, ASER, EC, and optimization problems for OIS." and p. 11: "the DNN model is employed to predict the associated performance metric values". Its inputs are system parameters and its output is a metric value (Table IV, p. 11), replacing Monte-Carlo runs (p. 16), not a decision on the link. If the reviewer reads the DNN as a learned function, the code would be function (performance prediction is outside the seven areas).
